displayName: Guitar Coach API - Redis dependency failures

documentation.content: More than 10 Redis operation failures (lock/cache/rate-limit clients) in a 5-minute window. Backed by redis_operation_failures_total (src/redis/redis-lock.service.ts, src/tasks/tasks.service.ts, src/auth/redis-rate-limit-storage.ts). Most Redis-backed features fail open, so this is an early-warning signal, not necessarily user-facing yet — check /health/ready and the reorder-lock's 503s (fail-closed by design) to gauge actual impact. VERIFY the metric.type filter below in Metrics Explorer before applying (see docs/monitoring/README.md).
